draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package contains no label-noise experiments. T1 reports only original-label F1 (91.4±0.4 for Thornbill-NER). The robustness criterion and noise-aware loss are described in the methods, but no perturbation condition or noise results are reported. The claim about robustness to label noise has no supporting evidence.

judgement.proposition: Thornbill-NER is somewhat robust to label noise in training annotations
judgement.expressed_strength: "appears somewhat robust" — hedged, moderate robustness claim
judgement.strongest_supported: No evidence in the package evaluates label noise; the package only reports performance on original labels, so no robustness-to-noise claim is supported.
